message.content: Grounding answers in retrieved evidence is beneficial because it helps mitigate unsupported claims. Essentially, it addresses the challenge of AI systems generating responses without sufficient real-world data. When retrieval supervision isn’t available, models need to be evaluated against existing data – like test cases or high-quality datasets – to ensure accuracy. This process helps to avoid misinterpretations of statistical results and ensures that decisions are based on potentially flawed inferences. It also allows for the inclusion of counter-evidence to correct incorrect inferences.
